intro: I'm Fernando Povinski. For over 7 years, I've turned business problems into clear, fast and maintainable systems, platforms and apps.
projectsTitle: Products that made it to the real world.
projectsIntro: A selection of platforms, apps and websites I helped take from planning to delivery.
aboutTitle: Code is only part of the delivery.
aboutText: I like to understand the problem before choosing the technology. I work close to product and business, with direct communication, pragmatic decisions and attention to what happens after launch.
principles: Architecture and interface should make life easier for users and maintainers.
I don't implement isolated screens. I seek to understand how each decision affects the product.
Performance, security and maintainability are part of the conversation from day one.
stackText: I work across the product journey, with deeper expertise in web applications, APIs, integrations and cloud infrastructure.
footerTitle: Have an interesting problem to solve?
footerText: Tell me a little about the project. I reply personally.
